title: result can be iterated and populate the wrong identity map

labels.name: blocker
labels.description: issue that must be resolved asap as it is preventing things from working

body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/discussions/7127

since the async session prebuffers rows, the linked examples show different behavior for async vs. sync.  however, the sync example produces invalid state: foo thinks its persistent in the session when it's actually not.  this is a bug.  the session is closed so there is no way to fetch the result here and this must raise.

```py
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, select, text, Integer, Column
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, sessionmaker

Base = declarative_base()
engine = create_engine("sqlite://")
session_maker = sessionmaker(engine)


class Foo(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'foo'
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)


def go_sync():
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        Base.metadata.drop_all(conn)
        Base.metadata.create_all(conn)
        conn.execute(text('INSERT INTO foo VALUES (1)'))

    with session_maker() as session:
        query = select(Foo).where(Foo.id == 1)
        result = session.execute(query)
    foo = result.scalar()

    assert inspect(foo).detached

go_sync()

```

it can raise minimalistically like this, but having it be more cleanly enforced at the result level would be better:

```diff
diff --git a/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/identity.py b/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/identity.py
index 7eec4fd8d8..4911135f6c 100644
--- a/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/identity.py
+++ b/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/identity.py
@@ -13,11 +13,15 @@ from .. import util
 
 
 class IdentityMap(object):
+
     def __init__(self):
         self._dict = {}
         self._modified = set()
         self._wr = weakref.ref(self)
 
+    def _kill(self):
+        self._add_unpresent = self._killed
+
     def keys(self):
         return self._dict.keys()
 
@@ -27,6 +31,9 @@ class IdentityMap(object):
     def add(self, state):
         raise NotImplementedError()
 
+    def _killed(self, *arg, **kw):
+        raise sa_exc.InvalidRequestError("Identity map is no longer valid.  Has the owning Session been closed?")
+
     def _add_unpresent(self, state, key):
         """optional inlined form of add() which can assume item isn't present
         in the map"""
diff --git a/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/session.py b/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/session.py
index f051d8df2c..d5fb8a8e1b 100644
--- a/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/session.py
+++ b/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/session.py
@@ -1836,6 +1836,7 @@ class Session(_SessionClassMethods):
         """
 
         all_states = self.identity_map.all_states() + list(self._new)
+        self.identity_map._kill()
         self.identity_map = identity.WeakInstanceDict()
         self._new = {}
         self._deleted = {}
```
